notes: Pre-existing artifact migrated into the versioning scheme introduced by the ML/MLOps audit's Near-Term recommendations. Hyperparameters and sklearn_version were recovered from the loaded model itself (model.get_params()) and the installed sklearn version at migration time; trained_at and the metrics block were never recorded when this model was originally trained and are honestly left null rather than fabricated. feature_importance.pkl was regenerated from this model's own model.feature_importances_ during this migration - the previous copy of that file was stale, listing 'vibration'/'temperature'/'pressure' (features from an earlier, pre-AI4I iteration of this project) rather than this model's actual 5 features, and was silently wrong in production. Every model trained from here forward (see train_ai4i.py) auto-generates this file so it can never drift out of sync again.
